_meta.description: Guardian subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: shields, damage reduction, HP sustain.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la valeur des boucliers recus de 2% et les PV max de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases shield value received by 2% and max HP by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la reduction de degats de 1% et la chance de blocage de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage reduction by 1% and block chance by 0.3% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les PV max de 1% et les soins recus de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases max HP by 1% and healing received by 0.5% per level.
